You are a senior data engineer generating the Silver layer of a medallion-architecture dbt plan.

Given a schema and pipeline context, produce a plan with:
  - bronze: list of ALL source table names (raw names only, no prefixes)
  - dimensions: Silver dimension models (dim_<entity>, SCD type 1 or 2)
  - facts: Silver fact models (fct_<entity>)

Rules:
  - Every source table must appear in bronze.
  - source_table in dimensions/facts must match a table name in bronze.
  - Dimension names: dim_<entity>. Fact names: fct_<entity>.
  - Choose SCD type 2 for slowly-changing entities (customers, employees); type 1 for others.
  - STRICT: Only create fct_* from tables whose role is "fact". Never create a fact from a
    dimension, bridge, or reference table.
  - STRICT: `columns` in every DimensionPlan MUST be an empty list []. Do not enumerate columns.
  - STRICT: fact `dimension_keys` must be FK columns that physically exist on the source table.
  - STRICT: fact `date_column` must be an actual date/timestamp column on the source table.
    If no date column exists on the table, look at its FK-referenced tables. If a parent table
    has a date/timestamp column (e.g. invoice_date on invoice), set date_column to that column
    name — the generator will add the JOIN automatically. Only use "" if no date is reachable
    via a single FK hop.
  - STRICT: fact `measures` must contain ONLY bare column names of numeric type (int, num/decimal,
    money). Column types are shown in the schema as :int, :num, :money. Do NOT include
    varchar, text, guid, bool, or :char columns as measures — they are identifiers, not metrics.
    Do NOT put SQL expressions in `measures`.
  - DERIVED MEASURES: When a business metric must be computed from multiple columns (e.g. revenue
    from quantity × price), use `derived_measures` instead of putting expressions in `measures`.
    Each entry has a `name` (SQL alias, e.g. "line_total") and `expression` (SQL-valid expression
    using only column names that exist on the source table, e.g. "orderqty * unitprice").
    Derived measures are rendered as `expression AS name` in the fact SELECT and are exposed to
    Gold as named columns. Common cases:
      - Revenue without a total column: {"name": "line_total", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice"}
      - Net revenue with discount: {"name": "net_revenue", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice - unitpricediscount"}
      - Good quantity: {"name": "good_qty", "expression": "orderqty - scrappedqty"}
  - Denormalize high-cardinality customer/user FKs (customer_id, user_id, account_id) onto
    the fact directly when reachable via one FK hop, so gold models can group by them.
  - For periodic snapshot tables (tracking inventory levels or balances over time, e.g.
    productinventory), include the snapshot date column in `dimension_keys` so it becomes
    part of the surrogate key and uniqueness tests pass.
  - Factless fact tables (no numeric measures, e.g. employeedepartmenthistory) are valid.
    Set `factless=true` and keep `measures` and `derived_measures` as empty lists.

Database schema:
  subscribers: columns=[id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, date_of_birth, national_id, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, postal_code, country, subscriber_type, status]
  accounts: columns=[id, subscriber_id, account_number, account_type, billing_cycle_day, credit_limit, outstanding_balance, currency, auto_pay_enabled, status, closed_at, created_at, updated_at], fks=[subscriber_id→subscribers]
  plans: columns=[id, plan_code, plan_name, plan_type, billing_cycle, base_price, data_allowance_mb, voice_minutes, sms_allowance, overage_data_rate_per_mb, overage_voice_rate_per_min, overage_sms_rate, is_unlimited_data, is_unlimited_voice, is_unlimited_sms]
  plan_features: columns=[id, plan_id, feature_name, feature_code, description, feature_type, monthly_cost, is_active, created_at, updated_at], fks=[plan_id→plans]
  devices: columns=[id, imei, make, model, device_type, os_type, os_version, hardware_version, purchase_date, warranty_expiry_date, status, subscriber_id, created_at, updated_at], fks=[subscriber_id→subscribers]
  sim_cards: columns=[id, iccid, msisdn, imsi, sim_type, status, subscriber_id, device_id, activation_date, deactivation_date, pin1, puk1, created_at, updated_at], fks=[subscriber_id→subscribers, device_id→devices]
  subscriptions: columns=[id, subscription_number, subscriber_id, account_id, plan_id, sim_card_id, device_id, start_date, end_date, contract_expiry_date, status, suspension_reason, cancellation_reason, monthly_cost, discount_amount], fks=[subscriber_id→subscribers, account_id→accounts, plan_id→plans, sim_card_id→sim_cards, device_id→devices]
  towers: columns=[id, tower_code, tower_name, latitude, longitude, altitude_meters, technology_type, operator, address, city, state, country, is_active, commissioned_date, decommissioned_date]
  coverage_areas: columns=[id, tower_id, area_name, technology_type, radius_km, signal_strength_dbm, frequency_band, max_download_mbps, max_upload_mbps, is_indoor_coverage, created_at, updated_at], fks=[tower_id→towers]
  call_records: columns=[id, subscription_id, sim_card_id, tower_id, call_type, caller_number, callee_number, call_start_time, call_end_time, duration_seconds, billable_duration_seconds, call_cost, is_roaming, roaming_country, termination_reason], fks=[subscription_id→subscriptions, sim_card_id→sim_cards, tower_id→towers]
  sms_records: columns=[id, subscription_id, sim_card_id, tower_id, sms_type, sender_number, recipient_number, sent_at, delivered_at, message_parts, sms_cost, is_roaming, roaming_country, delivery_status, created_at], fks=[subscription_id→subscriptions, sim_card_id→sim_cards, tower_id→towers]
  data_usage: columns=[id, subscription_id, sim_card_id, tower_id, session_start, session_end, bytes_downloaded, bytes_uploaded, total_bytes, technology_used, apn, is_roaming, roaming_country, session_cost, created_at], fks=[subscription_id→subscriptions, sim_card_id→sim_cards, tower_id→towers]
  invoices: columns=[id, invoice_number, account_id, subscriber_id, billing_period_start, billing_period_end, issue_date, due_date, subtotal, tax_amount, discount_amount, total_amount, amount_paid, amount_due, currency], fks=[account_id→accounts, subscriber_id→subscribers]
  invoice_items: columns=[id, invoice_id, subscription_id, item_type, description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, tax_rate, tax_amount, reference_period_start, reference_period_end, created_at], fks=[invoice_id→invoices, subscription_id→subscriptions]
  payments: columns=[id, payment_reference, invoice_id, account_id, subscriber_id, payment_method, payment_gateway, gateway_transaction_id, amount, currency, status, payment_date, failure_reason, refund_amount, refunded_at], fks=[invoice_id→invoices, account_id→accounts, subscriber_id→subscribers]

All source tables (all must appear in bronze): ['subscribers', 'accounts', 'plans', 'plan_features', 'devices', 'sim_cards', 'subscriptions', 'towers', 'coverage_areas', 'call_records', 'sms_records', 'data_usage', 'invoices', 'invoice_items', 'payments']

Pipeline context:
  Industry: telecom / telecommunications_operator
  Metrics:  monthly_recurring_revenue, average_revenue_per_user, data_usage_gb, call_minutes_billed, invoice_collection_rate, churn_rate
  Goals:    revenue_and_billing_analysis, network_usage_monitoring, subscriber_lifecycle_tracking, service_plan_performance
  Grain:    subscription

Table roles (from Agent 3):
  subscribers: dimension
  accounts: dimension
  plans: dimension
  plan_features: dimension
  devices: dimension
  sim_cards: dimension
  subscriptions: fact
  towers: dimension
  coverage_areas: dimension
  call_records: fact
  sms_records: fact
  data_usage: fact
  invoices: fact
  invoice_items: fact
  payments: fact

Numeric columns eligible as measures (use ONLY these in `measures`):
  subscriptions: account_id, monthly_cost, discount_amount
  call_records: call_cost
  sms_records: sms_cost
  data_usage: total_bytes, session_cost
  invoices: account_id, subtotal, tax_amount, discount_amount, total_amount, amount_paid, amount_due
  invoice_items: quantity, unit_price, line_total, tax_rate, tax_amount
  payments: account_id, amount, refund_amount

"invoice_items", "payments"], "dimensions": [{"name": "dim_subscriber", "source_table": "subscribers", "scd_type": 2, "grain": "entity", "columns": []}, {"name": "dim_account", "source_table": {"name": "dim_coverage_area", "source_table": "coverage_areas", "scd_type": 1, "grain": "entity", "columns": []}], "facts": [{"name": "fct_subscription", "source_table": "subscriptions", "grain": {"name": "bytes_uploaded", "expression": "bytes_uploaded"}, {"name": "total_gb", "expression": "total_bytes / 1073741824.0"}], "date_column": "session_start", "factless": false}, {"name": "fct_invoice", "source_table": "invoices", "grain": "transaction", "dimension_keys": ["account_id", "subscriber_id"], "measures": ["subtotal", "tax_amount", "discount_amount", "total_amount", "amount_paid", "amount_due"], "derived_measures": [{"name": "collection_rate", "expression": "CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN amount_paid / total_amount ELSE 0 END"}], "date_column": "issue_date",
